findings.title: RoleBinding names a ServiceAccount that does not exist
findings.cause: container worker exits because the API server refuses its ServiceAccount app, which no RoleBinding of namespace kd-rolebinding-subject-missing names: RoleBinding read-config grants Role configmap-reader to ServiceAccount apps, and there is no ServiceAccount apps, so nothing receives the permission; its log says: "wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden"; Deployment worker has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container worker exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container worker's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
Connecting to kubernetes.default.svc (10.96.0.1:443)
wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden

evidence.what: RoleBinding read-config grants Role configmap-reader to ServiceAccount apps
the pod runs as ServiceAccount app
evidence.command: kubectl get pod worker-7ff79c9999-wfjfj -n kd-rolebinding-subject-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.serviceAccountName}'

findings.fix: Set the subject of RoleBinding read-config to ServiceAccount app (a binding's subjects can be edited), if that is who it was meant for; or run the pods as ServiceAccount apps after creating it.
